facts.fact: L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says Niger had 9,746,822 e-money accounts, 441,764 of them active, and 31,980,545 transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel says the BCEAO lists 13 participants in Niger authorised to open PI-SPI services to the public, eleven banks plus Airtel Money Niger and i-FUTUR, as of 30 September 2026.
